books.title: Wings of Fire: An Autobiography
books.author_name: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
books.description: An inspiring autobiography recounting Dr. Kalam's journey from a humble childhood in Rameswaram to leading India's missile defense and space exploration programs.

books.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
books.description: The authoritative, comprehensive overview of the theory and practice of AI, covering machine learning, search, neural networks, robotics, and probabilistic reasoning.

books.title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
books.description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. Best practices for formatting, refactoring, and test-driven design.

books.title: Java: The Complete Reference
books.description: Fully updated for Java SE 17, this definitive guide explains how to develop, compile, debug, and run Java programs with extensive coverage of OOP, Generics, and concurrency.

books.title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)
books.description: The global benchmark text on data structures and algorithms, featuring rigorous mathematical foundations, dynamic programming, graph algorithms, and NP-completeness.

books.title: Computer Networks
books.description: Classic introduction to computer networking principles, TCP/IP protocol suite, wireless networks, network security, and internet routing architectures.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.description: A thrilling exploration of how an unremarkable ape became the ruler of planet Earth, traversing the Cognitive, Agricultural, and Scientific Revolutions.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.description: A portrait of the Jazz Age, telling the tragic story of Jay Gatsby and his obsessive pursuit of the unattainable Daisy Buchanan in 1920s Long Island.

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.description: Set in the American South during the Great Depression, an unforgettable novel of racial injustice and the destruction of innocence through the eyes of young Scout Finch.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.description: The witty and charming battle of wits between Elizabeth Bennet and the arrogant Mr. Darcy in 19th-century English countryside society.

books.title: Ignited Minds: Unleashing the Power Within India
books.author_name: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
books.description: Dr. Kalam addresses the youth of India, outlining a passionate blueprint for national development, education, scientific innovation, and spiritual strength.

books.title: Effective Java
books.description: Essential best practices for the Java platform. Covers lambdas, streams, generics, enums, annotations, and defensive programming techniques.
